/**
 * Retail catalogue: storefront copy, mapping, and pricing rules.
 * Downstream IDs stay server-side. Sheet-shaped rows are accepted by the adapter.
 *
 * socialpanelId values are SocialPanel24 service numbers confirmed from action=services.
 * Comments use per_1000 because panel rates are per 1,000 comments.
 */

/** @typedef {'per_1000'|'per_unit'|'package'|'per_comment'} RateUnit */

/**
 * @typedef {{
 *   id: string,
 *   platform: string,
 *   platformLabel: string,
 *   service: string,
 *   description: string,
 *   inputs: string[],
 *   visible: boolean,
 *   socialpanelId: string,
 *   rateUnit: RateUnit,
 *   retailCurrency: string,
 *   markupMultiplier: number,
 *   quantityStep: number,
 *   quantityDefault: number|null,
 *   packagePriceMinor: number|null,
 *   dripEnabled: boolean
 * }} RetailService
 */
